content:
maya: heads-up — observed persistent correctable ECC spikes + NIC flapping on eu-west rack5 (nodes gpu-rack5-10..13). GPU errors correlate with kernel oops on 2026-03-18T09:12Z, batch queue latency spiking, and several user jobs OOMing. Queues + preemptions up ~22%.

infra-bot: Alert: ECC_RATE_HIGH on gpu-rack5 (10-13) • NIC_FLAP detected • Opened ticket INF-3789

sam: can you paste the logs/snippet? also which models running — heavy sequence lengths?

maya: paste: ```
Mar 18 09:11:58 gpu-rack5-12 kernel: Correctable ECC error on GPU0: syndrome 0x1a
Mar 18 09:12:02 gpu-rack5-12 kernel: XID 79: GPU hang detected
Mar 18 09:12:08 gpu-rack5-12 nic0: link state changed up->down (0.5s)
Mar 18 09:12:10 redis: batch-queue: head latency 320ms -> 1.2s
```
Running: mix of customer gen (gpt-like) and long-context evals — few heavy 8k+ seqs pinned to dedicated pools.

liam: thanks. two quick asks: 1) can we avoid mass cancel for customers? 2) cost impact if we shift traffic to us-east on-demand?

sam: plan suggestion: 1) mark nodes admin:drain for new allocations 2) enable routing rule to prefer eu-west-fallback pool (lower perf) then us-east on overflow 3) start live drain on affected nodes with grace 20m 4) open RMA with vendor and schedule swap of suspicious PSUs+NICs.

maya: Agreed. will run drain command now. Running `redwoodctl node annotate gpu-rack5-12 admin=drain` then `redwoodctl drain --node gpu-rack5-10,gpu-rack5-11,gpu-rack5-12,gpu-rack5-13 --grace-period=1200 --no-evict-critical`

deploy-bot: rolling drain job started by maya: job id drain-2112350000 • nodes: 10,11,12,13 • ETA: ~20m • status: started

ryan: on routing: I'll flip the traffic weighting on the smart-router: 60% eu-west-fallback (quantized models), 40% us-east-dedicated overflow. We'll keep cost cap alerts on. If latency for SLOs degrades, fallback to regional queued mode (best-effort).

liam: cost note — moving to us-east on-demand + running larger batch windows increases token cost ~35% for the affected workload; suggest enabling quantized-4bit profile for gen-v2 for that routing rule to cut token runtime 18-22%.

ana: (typo, but actually 'ana') I spoke to vendor on call — RMA provisional for all 4 nodes pending repro. They asked for serials and pdu logs. maya can you attach `dmidecode` + PDU drain events?

maya: attaching quick outputs: ```
# dmidecode snippet gpu-rack5-12
System Serial: RW-AP-EU-01234
Chassis: Rack5-U12
# pdu logs excerpt
2026-03-18T09:10:58 PDU rack5-u12 power-cycler triggered by OCP: none
```
I'll drop full logs in INF-3789.

liam: while we're draining, can ops enable cache warmup on fallback pool? prefix caching will reduce token cost / latency for repeated chats.

sam: yes — enabling prefix cache for model-group 'gen-v2' on eu-west-fallback for 30m. Command: `redwoodctl cache set --model gen-v2 --ttl 1800 --warmup=true`

infra-bot: Node gpu-rack5-12 drain progress: evicted 8/12 pods • 4 heavy jobs still terminating (est 8m)

maya: monitoring queue drop/latency — so far no hard SLA breaches. one enterprise customer reported jitter ~220ms on inference, routed to fallback pool. Notified CSM on incident channel.

ryan: Ops decision: continue drain + RMA. If more ECC events appear elsewhere, we escalate to cross-region capacity plan. For now keep eu-west control-plane in read-only for new heavy pins.

ana/ana: RMA ticket created with vendor INF-3789 -> RMA-4521. ETA engineer onsite 2026-03-19. We'll replace NIC and PSU on arrival; if still failing, full node swap.

liam: TL;DR action items: maya — complete drain + logs to ticket; sam — enable cache & adjust routing; ryan — watch SLO and revert if spike; ana — RMA coordination; infra-bot — keep alerting on ECC > threshold.

maya: done — drain completed on nodes 10..13 at 09:34Z, all pods evacuated, nodes set to maintenance. Full logs uploaded to INF-3789.

deploy-bot: drain-2112350000 completed • nodes 10-13 maintenance=true • reroute applied: eu-west-weighting updated

ryan: I'll leave routing config sticky for next 6 hours and monitor. If unit cost > threshold for 10m, switch to regional degraded mode.

liam: thanks team. once RMA completes let's run a short soak and then reintroduce nodes with canary traffic (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

maya: noted. will also flag the node images for kernel patch and GPU firmware update prior to return to pool. Closing thread for now — will reopen if INF-3789 shows new data. :white_check_mark:
